messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Create a wallet-reference note for my current travel card that lists its annual fee and travel/dining earning rate, explains what happened to my existing and pending points, and flags any former travel benefits I should no longer count on when booking.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "create_doc", "arguments": {"body": "Travel Card Wallet Reference
Effective January 1, 2028

Current card terms
- Annual fee: $0.
- Travel and dining earning rate: 1.5 rewards points per dollar.
- Other purchases: 1 rewards point per dollar.
- Annual travel credit: None.

Points status
- Existing points remain in the same rewards account.
- Pending points also remain in the same rewards account.
- The product change did not require redeeming points or move them to a different rewards account.

Booking cautions: former benefits no longer available
- Do not count on the former $75 annual travel credit when budgeting for or booking travel; it ended immediately when the product change took effect.
- Do not count on the former included lounge passes/visits; they also ended immediately.
- The current card has no annual travel credit and no lounge-pass benefit.

Quick reference
Use 1.5 points/$ for eligible travel and dining purchases and 1 point/$ elsewhere.
